name: niyoads-cms
description: NiyoAds vehicle-operator CMS PWA (local-first; not published yet)

scripts.install:cms: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix plugins/niyoads-silent-gps && npm run build --prefix plugins/niyoads-silent-gps && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev:cms: concurrently -n cms-api,cms-web -c cyan,white "npm run start:dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build:cms: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.build:android: npm run build --prefix plugins/niyoads-silent-gps && npm run build:cap --prefix web
